correctness.rationale: The statistic counts overlapping adjacent 11 pairs, not runs. I reconstructed the eight states (previous input/output bit and carry), the exact 1/2-weight digit transitions, the zero-suffix carry expectation and F_a=e_000 M_1 M_0^(a-1) M_1 H. The characteristic identity det(lambda I-M_0)=lambda^6(lambda-1)(lambda-1/(2z)) makes later consecutive differences scale by 1/(2z) once a>=7. The explicitly factored F_8-F_7 has numerator degree 8 and denominator degree 9, so it has no nonnegative Laurent powers at infinity; the same is true for every later increment. Rational symbolic reconstruction of Q_1,...,Q_8 agrees with the six exceptions and the sharp plateau Q_a=(54+65z+44z^2+12z^3)/256 for all a>=7. The carry persistence probability O(2^-L) permits finite-cylinder approximation, proving natural density existence. Q_6 differs from Q_7 and all j>3 have zero mass, and any finite integer with larger change would give a positive-measure cylinder, ruling out pointwise j>3. Finite enumerations are corroboration, not a substitute for Cayley-Hamilton.
residual_risks: The full negative-tail distribution is not claimed to stabilize. Proof uses rational generating functions and infinite-tail cylinder approximation; direct finite enumeration alone does not prove the theorem.
